segments.title: Cold Open & Hype Train Check-In
segments.notes: Case opens the Friday broadcast; Hype Train appears briefly, discusses hell trips and parentage (mom Kurt Russell, dad the devil); Peter Gibbon slithers in from the walls.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon Reads Tampon Assault Story
segments.notes: Peter reads Page Six story about Alaya Baldwin arrested for throwing a used tampon at a bartender and fighting bouncers; chat poll to re-fire Peter fails (Greg2k saves him); Peter claims wall-lubrication necessity.

segments.title: Jacket Debate & Tampon-Throwing Debate
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate new crew jackets (chat votes for change); second debate on whether throwing unused tampons is acceptable — Crum argues blood is just liquid, Munch calls it tactical escalation; 50/50 split.

segments.title: AI-Generated Rat Penis Paper Retracted
segments.notes: Chet covers Frontiers in Cell Development Biology paper retracted for Midjourney-generated rat genitalia illustrations; Chet shows grotesque AI images (rat with tree-like penis, rat-plant hybrid); ChetAI not present.

segments.title: Trailer Roundup: Dragon Ball VHS, The Beautiful Game, I Saw the TV Glow, Is It Cake?
segments.notes: Trent and Chris watch 90s Dragon Ball VHS trailer (photorealistic dragon, Goku kicks crocodile), homeless World Cup film The Beautiful Game, A24 horror I Saw the TV Glow, and Is It Cake? season 3.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple: Willy's Chocolate Experience Disaster
segments.notes: Jeff covers Glasgow Willy Wonka immersive event (House of Illuminati) that used AI promo images but delivered empty warehouse; police called, refunds promised; organizer's ChatGPT apology letter dissected.

segments.title: ASMR Rocket Raccoon: Super Earth Discovery & Raid
segments.notes: ASMR Rocket Raccoon reads NASA discovery of super-Earth TOI-715b (1.5x Earth, 137 ly away, habitable zone); whisper-raps about space genitals; raids Ovali to close broadcast.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors flagship broadcast; manages chaotic studio including Peter Gibbon poll, Munch/Crum jacket debate, and segment handoffs.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Runs polls, manages stream deck, refuses to fire Craig the security guard; maintains diplomatic immunity.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Emerges from walls to read Alaya Baldwin tampon assault story; survives chat re-fire poll; claims slime lubrication necessary for wall living.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Brief check-in; claims trips to hell when unfollowed; declares mother is Kurt Russell, father the devil.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debates Crum on new jackets (wants fresh look) and tampon throwing (tactical escalation risk); claims chat now his after win streak.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defends classic jacket; argues blood is just liquid so used tampon throws acceptable; spirals into 'dark Crum' after win.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Commandeers broadcast for AI rat penis paper; shows grotesque Midjourney images; claims Pantera Bread pop-up dining experience.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Covers Willy's Chocolate Experience disaster; dissects organizer's AI apology letter; promises to make theme music.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: field correspondent. Hosts At the Movies from theater; watches trailers with Chris; emotional over Beautiful Game trailer.

characters.name: Chris
characters.notes: contributor. Co-hosts At the Movies; defends Dragon Ball GT; teases Trent's media literacy.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell's Friday broadcast veers from a tampon-assault police blotter into a dual Munch & Crum debate on crew jackets and biohazard etiquette, then pivots to Chet's forensic takedown of an AI-hallucinated rat-phallus paper. The second hour sends Trent and Chris to the movies for a Dragon Ball VHS gem and A24 horror, Jeff Ripple dissects the Glasgow Willy Wonka warehouse fiasco, and ASMR Rocket Raccoon closes with a super-Earth discovery and a whisper-rap about space genitals before raiding Ovali.
